helpDrawDiscard: dd <idx,idx>         take the discard pile (natural pair indices)
promptDrawHelpDiscard: dd <idx,idx>: take the discard pile (natural pair indices)
frozenPickupNote: Discard pile frozen: taking it needs a natural pair matching the top card
promptMeldHelp: m <idx,idx,idx;idx,idx,idx>: lay down meld(s) (; separates groups)
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround: advance to next round
drawBlockerPileEmpty: * The discard pile is empty, so it cannot be taken
drawBlockerBlackThreeTop: * A black three is on top, so the discard pile cannot be taken
drawBlockerWildTop: * A wild card is on top, so the discard pile cannot be taken
drawBlockerNoPairInHand: * Your hand has no natural pair matching the top rank, so the pile cannot be taken yet
concealedBonusHint: Concealed go-out available: going out with no initial meld pays {{bonus}} instead of {{normal}}
hintReasonDrawStock: no useful pair matches the discard top, so draw from stock
hintReasonDrawDiscard: a natural pair matches the discard top, so take the pile
errBlackThreeCannotTakeDiscardPile: You cannot take the discard pile when a black three is on top.
errWildCardCannotTakeDiscardPile: You cannot take the discard pile when a wild card is on top.
errNaturalPairIndicesRequired: Select the indices of a natural pair (two natural cards of the same rank).
errCardIndexOutOfRange: The card index is out of range.
errSameCard: You cannot select the same card twice.
errPairMustBeNatural: The pair must contain natural cards, not wild cards.
errPairRankMismatch: The pair's rank must match the top card of the discard pile.
errInitialMeldMinimumNotMet: The initial meld minimum of {{min}} points is not met (current value: {{score}}).
errTopCardMustBeMelded: When you take the discard pile, you must meld its top card.
errPozzettoRequiredToGoOut: You must take the pozzetto before going out.
errCanastaRequiredToGoOut: You need at least one canasta to go out.
errHandMustHaveAtMostOneCardToGoOut: You must have zero or one card in hand to go out.
errMeldNeedsAtLeastThreeCards: A meld needs at least three cards.
errMeldCardsMustHaveSameRank: A meld must contain cards of the same rank.
errMeldNeedsAtLeastTwoNaturalCards: A meld needs at least two natural cards.
errMeldAllowsAtMostThreeWildCards: A meld can contain at most three wild cards.
errWildCardsCannotExceedNaturalCards: Wild cards cannot outnumber natural cards.
errMeldCardRankMismatch: A rank {{cardRank}} card cannot be added to a rank {{meldRank}} meld.
errSequenceMustUseSameSuit: A sequence must use cards of the same suit.
errSequenceCannotDuplicateRank: A sequence cannot contain the same rank twice.
errSequenceRanksNotConsecutive: The ranks in a sequence must be consecutive.
errWildCardsExceedSequenceRange: Wild cards cannot extend a sequence beyond the rank range.
log.drawDiscard: {{name}} picks up the discard pile ({{cards}} cards)
